missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Документ' stays nominative as the subject. 'Этот' points at it, and 'важный' is the agreeing masculine adjective. A simple descriptive sentence.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Документ' is the accusative direct object of 'подписал'; masculine inanimate nouns keep the nominative form. 'Важный' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'нет'. 'Документа' is the genitive required by 'нет' to express absence. 'Этого' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. 'Документу' is dative, governed by the preposition 'к', expressing addition to it. 'Подпись' is the accusative object added.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'над'. 'Документом' is instrumental, governed by 'над' with 'работать'. 'Важным' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Документе' is prepositional after 'в', the location of the error. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional, and 'ошибка' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Документы' is the nominative plural subject of 'лежат'. 'Все' quantifies them, and 'на столе' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after 'много'. 'Документов' is the genitive plural required by 'много'. 'Подписать' is the infinitive, and 'мне нужно' frames the obligation.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Документ' is the accusative direct object of 'читаю'; the masculine inanimate form matches the nominative. 'Этот' agrees, and 'внимательно' adds manner.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Документе' is prepositional after 'об', the topic of discussion. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
